defs.def: a container made of paper or plastic, that opens at the top, used especially in shops/stores 常构成复合词

ex.s: Among the bag makers' argument: many cities with bans still allow shoppers to purchase paper bags, which are easily recycled but require more energy to produce and transport.
ex.t: 在塑料袋生产商的说法中还提到：许多实施禁令的城市仍允许购物者购买纸袋，纸袋易于回收，但生产和运输耗能更多。

ex.s: One study found that a cotton bag must be used at least 131 times to be better for the planet than plastic.
ex.t: 一项研究发现，一个棉布袋必须至少使用131次，才比塑料袋对环境更有利。

ex.s: The industry has also taken aim at the product that has appeared as its replacement: reusable shopping bags.
ex.t: 可重复使用的购物袋越结实，使用寿命越长，抵消的塑料袋使用量就越多。

ex.s: I was back teaching after an absence of 15 years, dealing with the various kinds of "forbidden fruit" that come out of book bags.
ex.t: 在离开教学15年之后，我重新开始教书，面对着孩子们从书包里掏出的各种各样的‘禁果’。

ex.s: All over the world you can see kids playing to their hearts' content with a ball made of plastic bags; just like Pelé did when he was a boy.
ex.t: 你知道吗，秋季\/冬天即将来临。

ex.s: Because of our efforts, our daughter Georgia did decide to donate a large bag of toys to a little girl whose mother was unable to pay for her holiday due to illness.
ex.t: 由于我们的努力，女儿Georgia确实决定把一个大袋子装的玩具捐赠给一个小女孩，她的母亲因病无力支付她过节的费用。

ex.s: The stronger a reusable bag is, the longer its life and the more plastic-bag use it cancels out.
ex.t: 可重复使用袋子越结实，使用寿命越长，抵消掉的塑料袋使用就越多。

defs.def: a strong container made from cloth, plastic, leather, etc., usually with one or two handles, used to carry things in when shopping or travelling 手提包；旅行袋

ex.s: Then it attacked the back of Mac's bike, tearing open his tent bag.
ex.t: 然后它开始攻击麦克自行车的后部，撕开了他的帐篷包。

ex.s: What is even more interesting is that one of Stein's jobs is defending an industry behind the plastic shopping bags.
ex.t: 更有趣的是，斯坦的工作之一是为塑料购物袋背后的产业辩护。

ex.s: They are less strong than plastic bags.
ex.t: 生产它们需要更多能源。

ex.s: B: I will bring a reusable bag when I go shopping.
ex.t: 现在给这些体育项目分类。

defs.def: the amount contained in a bag 一袋（的量）

ex.s: “The kids literally come to school with bags of snacks and large bottles of soft drinks,” she says.
ex.t: “孩子们真的是带着一袋袋零食和大瓶软饮料来上学的，”她说。

ex.s: One night, in my early 40s, I dreamed that a big woman in red approached me, handed me a bag of paints, and told me to start painting.
ex.t: 在我40岁出头的一个夜晚，我梦见一个穿红衣的高大女人走近我，递给我一袋颜料，让我开始画画。

defs.def: a large amount or a large number of sth 大量；很多

ex.s: Pack a bag cut a cake, guess which juice container holds the most liquid, and much more.
ex.t: 装一个袋子、切一块蛋糕、猜猜哪个果汁容器装的水最多，还有很多其他活动。

ex.s: They should also prepare plenty of reusable bags to carry their "new" clothes home.
ex.t: 他们还应该准备大量可重复使用的袋子，把"新"衣服运回家。

ex.s: The white bags were then deflated in about half an hour to lower the sequoia's root ball to the bottom of its hole, The bags were removed, but the metal bars were left with the tree because they rust and degrade over a number of years.
ex.t: 然后白色气囊在约半小时内放气，将红杉根球降到坑底，气囊被取出，但钢条留在树旁，因为它们会在数年内生锈降解。

defs.def: dark circles or loose folds of skin under the eyes, as a result of getting old or lack of sleep 黑眼圈；眼袋

ex.s: Remove the skin and place them in plastic bags or containers and freeze.
ex.t: 她的皮肤仍然光滑，头发依然乌黑直顺，慢跑让她保持了苗条和健康。

ex.s: Campers, in my eyes, were people who enjoyed insect bites, ill-cooked meals, and uncomfortable sleeping bags.
ex.t: 在我眼中，露营者是那些喜欢蚊虫叮咬、半生不熟的食物和不舒服睡袋的人。

ex.s: The bags waiting there were then inflated further to take the weight of the sequoia while the transportation bags were deflated and removed from under the tree.
ex.t: 在接下来的五年里，当地公园服务部门将在巨杉的新家对其进行监测和维护。

defs.def: an insulting word for an unpleasant or bad-tempered older woman 丑妇，泼妇（指讨厌或坏脾气的年长女人）

ex.s: There a second set of partially inflated bags (shown in white) waited inside the hole.
ex.t: 在那里，第二组部分充气的气囊（以白色显示）在坑内等候。

defs.def: all the birds, animals, etc. shot or caught on one occasion （一次）猎获物

ex.s: Single-use plastic bags are used at most a few times before they   4   (throw) away.
ex.t: 一次性塑料袋最多使用几次就会被___4___（throw）掉。

ex.s: All campers should bring their own bagged lunch and snacks.
ex.t: 所有营员应自带午餐和零食。

ex.s: And while plastic bags may be ugly to look at, they represent a small percentage of all garbage on the ground today.z.x.xk
ex.t: 而且尽管塑料袋看着可能丑，但它们只占如今地面所有垃圾的很小比例。z.x.xk

ex.s: They will be kept in transport bags all the time.
ex.t: 理解预算线的经济概念

defs.def: to put sth into bags 把 … 装进袋子

ex.s: They hope paper bags will be banned someday too and want shoppers to use the same reusable bags for years.
ex.t: 他们希望有一天纸袋也会被禁，并希望购物者多年来一直使用同一个可重复使用的袋子。

ex.s: The team left 100 wax worms on a commercial polyethylene shopping bag for 12 hours, and the worms consumed and broke down about 92 milligrams, or almost 3% of it.
ex.t: 该团队把100只蜡虫放在一个商用聚乙烯购物袋上12小时，这些虫消耗并分解了约92毫克，即近3%的袋子。

ex.s: (Note: A "doggy bag" is a bag or box in which you take unfinished food home from a restaurant.) You see a sign in a supermarket saying "3 for 2".
ex.t: （注："打包袋"是一种袋子或盒子，用来把餐厅没吃完的食物带回家。）你在超市看到一个牌子写着"3件2元"。

ex.s: The boy lifted the last bag onto his shoulder, and flashed a bright smile.
ex.t: 男孩把最后一个袋子扛到肩上，露出了灿烂的笑容。

ex.s: My mother was putting her groceries into shopping bags when a   45   came up to her and said, "Here are the things that you   46  ." handing her the rubbing alcohol and the   47  .
ex.t: 我母亲正把买来的食品杂货装进购物袋，这时一个___45___走到她面前说：“这是你___46___的东西。”一边把医用酒精和___47___递给她。

ex.s: Focused on balancing the bags, she didn’t notice her wallet falling out of her pocket.
ex.t: 专注于保持袋子平衡，她没注意到钱包从口袋里掉了出来。

ex.s: Filled with   64   (curious), the artist packed his bags and left.
ex.t: 充满   64  （好奇心），这位艺术家收拾行李离开了。

ex.s: Many of these bags end up in the ocean where larger ones can trop sea creatures, such as turtles and dolphins.
ex.t: 这些袋子中有许多最终流入海洋，较大的袋子会困住海龟和海豚等海洋生物。

ex.s: Over time, the bags fall apart   6   countless tiny pieces, and fish cam accidentally eat some of them.
ex.t: 随着时间的推移，这些袋子____6____破碎成无数小碎片，鱼可能会不小心吃到一些。

ex.s: Now, lots of   7  (country)and regions are taking action to ban the sale of such bags to stop people using them.
ex.t: 现在，许多____7____（country）和地区正采取行动禁止出售此类袋子，以阻止人们使用它们。

ex.s: Americans use more than 100 billion thin film plastic bags every year.
ex.t: 这些袋子在加州约90个城市被禁止使用，包括洛杉矶。

ex.s: The bags are prohibited in some 90 cities in California, including Los Angeles.
ex.t: 包括洛杉矶在内的加利福尼亚州约90个城市禁止这些袋子。

ex.s: However, longer-lasting reusable bags often require more energy to make.
ex.t: 一项研究发现，一个棉布袋必须至少使用131次才能比塑料袋更有利于环境。

ex.s: Argue for the use of plastic bags.
ex.t: 说要用塑料袋

ex.s: Bans on plastic bags.
ex.t: 城市发展的影响。

ex.s: Plastic bags hung in trees.
ex.t: 塑料袋挂在树上。

ex.s: What is a disadvantage of reusable bags according to plastic-bag makers?
ex.t: 根据塑料袋生产商的说法，可重复使用袋子有什么缺点？

ex.s: By underinflating the front bags, the team allowed the platform carrying the tree to roll up the ramp and out of the hole while staying level, A trailer hauled the tree along as team members removed the airbags from the back of the platform and replaced them in the front.
ex.t: 通过给前袋少充气，团队让载树的平台在保持水平的情况下滚上坡道出坑，拖车拖着树前行，成员们从平台后方取下气囊补到前方。

ex.s: help make plastic bags
ex.t: 应该指出的是，加州在这方面并不是领先的。

ex.s: It fits into most sport bags.
ex.t: 它能放进大多数运动包里。

ex.s: If you want time to have breakfast with your family, save some time the night before by setting out clothes, shoes, and bags.
ex.t: 如果你想有时间和家人一起吃早餐，前一天晚上就把衣服、鞋子和包准备好来节省时间。

defs.def: to catch or kill an animal 捕获，猎杀（动物）
to score a goal, point, etc. 得分
to claim sth as yours before sb else claims it; to take sth before sb else can get it 抢占；占有

ex.s: Take care of her bags.
ex.t: 照看她的包。

defs.def: to criticize sb/sth 批评；挑剔；指责
to decide not to do sth because you think it will not be successful or because you think it will be better to do it later （认为不会成功或以后做会更好而）放弃，取消

ex.s: You ask your customer whether he/she needs a doggie bag.
ex.t: 你询问顾客是否需要打包袋。
